content.short: PlayArts enables creators to own and monetize their AI-generated content through blockchain technology.
content.description: PlayArts is a blockchain-powered AI creation platform that positions AI as a collaborative partner for digital content creators, enabling a seamless workflow from idea to ownership. Founded in 2024, it leverages GPU Mesh technology and ERC-1155 tokenization to grant true ownership of AI-generated content, prompts, and techniques. By empowering creators to own their work, it reduces infrastructure costs through distributed computing and enables monetization with automated royalty distribution.
